subject.title: improve(control-ui): expose linear session positions in chat picker

question: Should maintainers accept this narrow Control UI chat picker accessibility slice after resolving the current merge conflict, while keeping https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/82450 open for the broader workspace design?
rationale: The patch is focused and proven, but it changes visible and screen-reader wording, overlaps a broader accessibility product request, has a protected `maintainer` label, and cannot be merged in its current dirty state.

options.title: Land the narrow slice
options.body: Approve the row-number and aria-label affordance after the branch is refreshed and required checks pass, without treating it as the full linear workspace solution.

options.title: Request wording changes
options.body: Ask for different visible ordinal treatment or screen-reader phrasing before merge if maintainers want a different accessibility pattern.

options.title: Pause for broader design
options.body: Hold this PR until the larger linear persistent workspace direction is decided, accepting that this smaller picker improvement waits.

recommendation.title: Land the narrow slice
recommendation.body: Approve the row-number and aria-label affordance after the branch is refreshed and required checks pass, without treating it as the full linear workspace solution.

likelyOwner.reason: The remaining human choice includes Control UI localized UX wording, and recent history ties vincentkoc to the relevant i18n surface.
